title: Office front page — round 3: the rename pencil and the faint ending

steps.headline: Rename is now the session switcher's pencil, right after each file's name.
steps.changed: Your R2-4 note: the same pencil, size and place as renaming a session, always showing (muted until pointed at). The rename button left the hover group, which is now Ask about this, View in folder and More.
steps.notice: Clicking the pencil opens the rename popup; clicking anywhere else on the row still opens the file.
steps.risk: Every row now carries a small pencil at rest, as the session switcher's rows do.

steps.headline: The popup shows a faint .docx right after the name you type, instead of the line under the box.
steps.changed: Your R2-3 note: the ending follows your text as you type, in a faint colour, and isn't part of what you can edit.
steps.notice: The popup is a line shorter.
steps.risk: A name longer than the box scrolls inside it; the faint ending then stays put rather than following the hidden end of the name.
